"""AC2: a valid 10% code makes the $100 cart $90, and clears an expired code's error."""

from conftest import ERROR, TOTAL, apply_code


def test_ac2_valid_code_after_expired(checkout):
    fresh = checkout()
    apply_code(fresh, "SAVE10")
    assert fresh.inner_text(TOTAL) == "Total: $90"
    page = checkout()
    apply_code(page, "EXPIRED")
    assert page.locator(ERROR).is_visible(), "the expired code showed no error to clear"
    apply_code(page, "SAVE10")
    assert not page.locator(ERROR).is_visible(), "the error stayed after a valid code"
    assert page.inner_text(TOTAL) == "Total: $90"
